foreignObject.div: Now, let's trace the complete lifecycle of a request as it travels through the application. Execution begins at user_route. Notice how data transitions across each architectural boundary: then request reaches user_route in api.py with name: str., then user_route invokes get_user in app.py., then get_user invokes load_user in app.py., then load_user instantiates class user.. Finally, the terminal result—dict[str, str]—is returned safely to the caller, ensuring a predictable execution lifecycle.
